about.title: History of Salihli
about.content: To tell the history of Salihli, one must start with the Ancient City of Sardis (SART). Sardis was founded in the Gediz basin, on the northern slopes of the hills to the west of Bozdağ. It showed great development especially in the 7th-6th centuries BC, becoming the capital of the Lydian state. Industrial inventions, money, and international migration started here. Sardis maintained its importance as a center during the Persian, Roman, and Byzantine periods.

history.title: Journey to History
history.description: Salihli is home to a rich historical heritage stretching from ancient times to the present day. Sardis, the capital of the Lydian Kingdom where money was invented, is the most precious treasure of these lands. As an important metropolis during the Roman Empire, the city hosted one of the first seven churches of Christianity. During the Byzantine period, it maintained its importance as a strategic episcopal center. This journey invites you to trace the footsteps of thousands of years of civilizations.

lidya_yolu.name: Lydian Way Bicycle Route
lidya_yolu.description: A path full of history and nature following the traces of the ancient Lydian civilization, starting from Sardis Ancient City and stretching to the foothills of the Bozdağ Mountains.

salihli_alasehir.name: Salihli-Alaşehir Bicycle Route
salihli_alasehir.description: A pleasant trail starting from Salihli and extending to Alaşehir, passing through the region's fertile agricultural lands and world-famous vineyards.

kursunlu_marmara.name: Kurşunlu-Marmara Bicycle Route
kursunlu_marmara.description: A comprehensive bicycle trail starting from Kurşunlu Thermal Springs to the shores of Lake Marmara, offering unique natural views.

kula_salihli_geopark.name: Kula-Salihli Geopark Bicycle Route
kula_salihli_geopark.description: A fascinating trail passing through the unique geological formations of the Kula-Salihli UNESCO Global Geopark, accompanied by volcanic cones and lava flows.

kursunlu.name: Kurşunlu Walking Route
kursunlu.description: A pleasant trail in the unique nature of Kurşunlu Thermal Springs, stretching along the valley where you will feel the coolness of the healing waters.

kursunlu_allahdiyen.name: Kurşunlu-Allahdiyen Walking Route
kursunlu_allahdiyen.description: A medium-difficulty nature walk trail starting from Kurşunlu Thermal Springs to Allahdiyen village, accompanied by pine trees and the sound of the stream.

kayabasi.name: Salihli Kayabaşı Walking Route
kayabasi.description: A peaceful walking trail in the Kayabaşı area of Salihli, intertwined with nature, offering magnificent views and rock formations.
